quest.title: Anna the Adventurer!
quest.description: It appears that Anna from Mondstadt has successfully become an adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Alright. Let's work hard today, too!

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Of course! Being an adventurer is really interesting!

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Well... I still am a bit unfamiliar with what to do while undertaking commissions, though.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Traveler, would you mind coming with me again? I still have things I'd like to ask you.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Then let's set out. Today's commission is...

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Huh... So we're escorting... another transport balloon.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Would you? Hehe, sure! There's still so much I could learn from you.

talks.objective: Go with Anna to complete her Adventurers' Guild commission

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Fischl. You ran off too quickly! That was really risky...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Hah! Mine thundering retribution spares not any evildoers...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Oh, it's Fischl and Bennett! Hello there!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Anna. And the Traveler, too! Are you on a commission?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Ah, you have arrived, O you who art blessed by the Prinzessin! Surely were you led here by the weft of fate.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein wishes to say that she is pleased to have met you by chance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm accompanying Anna on her commission.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: That's right. The Traveler and I were just escorting this transport balloon.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: But all of a sudden, a whole bunch of Treasure Hoarders came charging at us...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Uh, I'm terribly sorry about that. That was my fault.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Fischl and I accepted a commission to investigate the whereabouts of a certain band of Treasure Hoarders.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oz managed to catch their trail, and we were about to capture them... And then I tripped over a branch and fell over.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: The noise startled those Treasure Hoarders, who turned and fled. We had no choice but to keep chasing them...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: There was never any reason to fret. The violet light of conviction was ever fated to sever the destinies of those foul rogues.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: But Mein Fräulein, was it not the Traveler who ultimately apprehended them?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: O—Oz!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: W—Well, anyway, thanks for your help this time. It really was fortunate that you were there to bar their path.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Looks like my luck's pretty good today, huh!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Glad I could help.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hehe. Well then, guess we'll haul these Treasure Hoarders back to the Guild. Be careful now — and don't forget to watch your step!

talks.objective: Go with Anna to complete her Adventurers' Guild commission

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Bennett's as reliable as ever, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: And Fischl... Her words are as impressive as ever!

choices.text: What's your impression of Bennett so far?

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: When I first joined the Guild, he answered a lot of my questions and gave me lots of assistance.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: But I've heard that he has especially bad luck.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: That's just not fair. He's such a nice person...

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Well, guess we've finished this commission either way. Thank you, Traveler. I'm going to report back to the Guild now.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Still, why did I get transport balloon escort a few days in a row? Doesn't the Guild have any other commissions?

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Sh—She's really awesome as well! Her archery is great, and she's cleared lots of commissions.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: I don't really understand the things that she says...

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: But she's still a very experienced adventurer. W—Wait, no, she's an investigator!

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Please take care of Anna, Traveler. Her excitement might have gotten to her head lately...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you not want her to become an adventurer?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I respect my sister's wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Now that she's well again after such a long struggle with her illness, she deserves a chance to pursue her dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: As her brother, I'll support her... all the way.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: That's all I have to say.

talks.objective: Proceed onward and check the situation out
Proceed onward and check the situation out
